description: You speak, and then you sit

participation.context: Named the wait, refused a rewrite, and kept the page for home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the plot on the door and refused new cuts.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Heard the shape of the part and told him not to read the page.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Counted the two hours, kept the laugh, and told him to save the proclamation.
participation.name: Will Kemp

relations.note: the book-keeper, the plot on the door
relations.quote: I will not rewrite him before dinner.
The laugh is yours. The waiting is mine.

story.body: You settled Egeon with Garnish, Burbage and Kemp. The book stays as it is. You speak, and then you sit two hours. You went home to your own page and did not read it at them.

relations.note: the book-keeper, the plot on the door
relations.quote: I will not rewrite him before dinner.
The laugh is yours. The waiting is mine.

title: Rehearsed Egeon's speech and the two-hour wait

description: Two titles, and you do not cross

participation.context: Read the two titles and did not leave the inn.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the Cross Keys bill and the Rose's bill. You went in to play, and you did not cross to the Rose.

title: Read the Cross Keys bill and the Rose's bill

participation.context: Named the two cold hours, kept the twenty pounds off his own purse, and refused the page.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stood on the hamper, roared the line twice, and took the glove.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Said nothing while Kemp got the height, then threw the glove, and asked nothing that was granted.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Said they will be paid as slowly as we are, and named Monday's Errors without a sum.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Counted the two court days, and said she is keeping two dogs and feeding neither.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

relations.quote: You have made them quiet, Will, and you were mocking.
I am not reading him out in a tiring-room.
It is not mine to fetch, John.

story.body: After Errors you sat with Kemp, Burbage, Heminges and Pope. Kemp did Alleyn from a hamper. The line quieted the room, Heminges spoke of slow pay, Pope spoke of two dogs, and the second roar earned a glove. You named the twenty pounds as not yet had, and you did not read Berowne.

relations.quote: You have made them quiet, Will, and you were mocking.
I am not reading him out in a tiring-room.
It is not mine to fetch, John.

title: Heard Kemp do Alleyn's line from a hamper
